notes.title: "FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL" is available for pre-order today!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681582/1aeb8637fdc866595424185bb9a1a8e822c21173.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are pleased to announce that [b]"FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL"[/b] is now available for pre-order on Steam![/p][p]Purchase during pre-order period and the first 14 days of launch to receive [b]10% off[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681582/8529f5097f035403e3637fc6afa13074392e4c33.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Pre-order to receive the in game item, [b]Accessory -"Furball" in 3 Color Varieties[/b]! (*1)[/p][p]For a limited time, receive [b]Akemi Costume: Saki's Battle Suit from "OneeChanbara ORIGIN"[/b] as an early purchase bonus. (*2)[/p][p][/p][p]PRE-ORDER NOW:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3696410/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Official Website: [url="https://www.d3p.co.jp/zmg/en/"]https://www.d3p.co.jp/zmg/en/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]*1 This offer is only available to customers who purchase the product through pre-order by 23:59 (PDT) on October 22nd, 2025.[/p][p]*2 This offer is only available to customers who purchase the product by 2:00 (PST) on April 1st, 2026.[/p]

notes.title: 主題歌「戦え！マシンガールZu」カラオケバージョン公開！
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="JocrMcuMwn0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]サイボーグJKがブラック企業をぶっ潰す！（…までを生配信するアクション）[/p][p]『ゼンシンマシンガール』主題歌「戦え！マシンガールZu」のカラオケバージョンを公開！[/p][p][/p][p]一度耳にしたらクセになると一部の民に話題の主題歌がカラオケ配信決定！[/p][p]……するといいなぁという期待を込めて作ったトレーラーです。[/p][p]みんなで歌えば盛り上がること間違いなし!? 間違いあり!?[/p][p][/p][p]『ゼンシンマシンガール』の予約は後日開始予定。ウィッシュリスト登録で最新情報をお届け！[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3696410/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]▼公式サイトはこちら[/p][p] [url="https://www.d3p.co.jp/zmg/"]https://www.d3p.co.jp/zmg/[/url][/p]

notes.title: "FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL" will be available on October 23rd!!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="-IVtzcKl89k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We are excited to announce a brand-new explosive action shooter [b]Full Metal Schoolgirl[/b] is scheduled for a worldwide release on October 23rd, 2025 on Steam! Pre-order will start at a later date.[/p][p][/p][p]A fully armed cyborg heroine storms into a giant corporation and unleashes a relentless barrage of gunfire and sword action in this exhilarating cyborg schoolgirl action adventure. New heroines battle in a game that combines the close combat of "Onechanbara” with the gun battles of “Earth Defense Force.”[/p][p][/p][p]WISHLIST NOW:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3696410/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Official Website: [url="https://www.d3p.co.jp/zmg/en/"]https://www.d3p.co.jp/zmg/en/[/url][/p]
